server_name.description: Display name of the server visible to players in the browser.

game_mode.description: Game mode (e.g., ctf, dm, dd, race, duel). Must match a supported mode.

max_players.description: Maximum number of concurrent players allowed.

game_port.description: UDP port used for game traffic.

admin_http_port.description: HTTP port for admin interface (0 disables it).

server_password.description: Password required to join the server. Leave empty for open access.

admin_password.description: Password to authenticate as admin in-game (e.g., via /admin command).

items.description: Map name(s) to cycle through. The first map is loaded at start.

maps.description: Ordered list of maps for rotation (minimum of one required).

dedicated.description: Run the server in dedicated mode (no local player, no GUI).

time_limit.description: Time in minutes per map before rotating. Set to 0 for no limit.

score_limit.description: Score required to win/rotate (e.g., flag captures in CTF). Set to 0 for no limit.

names_in_spectator.description: Show player names in spectator list.

rate.description: Packet rate limit (bytes/sec) per client to reduce bandwidth.

min_ping.description: Minimum acceptable ping (ms); below this, clients may be warned.

max_ping.description: Maximum acceptable ping (ms); clients above this may be disconnected.

log_file.description: Path to write server log. Empty string disables logging.

items.description: Master server address (host:port) to register with.

master_servers.description: List of master servers for public server listing. Leave empty or add a dummy entry to disable registration.

extra_options.description: Additional server options not covered by this schema, passed as-is.
